jonah: I'll draft JSON-LD product + FAQ. Keep FAQ answers short.

leo: Redirects  I have 6 old slugs to map. Will open infra PR once mapping is confirmed. Need exact destination slugs.

nina: Also proposal for webinar UTMs: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=webinar-cta, utm_campaign=q2-launch. Landing page canonical -> itself; blog CTAs include UTMs but canonical -> main product page.

ops-bot: Reminder: nightly crawl at 02:30 UTC will flag new 404s and redirect chains.

sara-m: I'll share CSV by EOD tomorrow. Jonah will you paste JSON-LD draft here when ready?

jonah: Yep. Posting minimal product JSON-LD next: ```{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Product","name":"Redwood Inference","description":"High-performance LLM inference platform."}```

nina: Great. Leo tag reviewers when PR is ready and we'll run Screaming Frog pre/post. Thanks! :rocket:
